title: Which State Unemployment Claims Alerts Survive the Next Release?
grain: One US state or covered territory and initial-claims week, with two actual release dates
dataset: Unemployment Insurance Weekly Claims, advance state tables
question: Which state-level claims alerts survive the switch from first publication to claimant-residence reporting?
design: Extract consecutive dated weekly releases and verify each printed state change. Rank anomalies after state-specific scale and seasonality adjustment. Compare a seasonal prior, the raw release and a shrunk historical revision adjustment against the residence-based top-K in the next publication. Hold out late dates and respect label publication.
boundary: The advance column is reported by liable state and includes a workshare proxy. The next release uses state of residence. The ranked target is a later published measure, not a directly observed employment shock.
redistribution: Derived government counts. Consecutive publication dates are retained for audit.

fields.week: Saturday at end of claims week
fields.residence: Prior-week claims printed in following release
